channel.title: Pier & Point · Rich Sorro Commons
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Rich Sorro Commons (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Rich Sorro Commons: Mission Housing's page lists Rich Sorro Commons at 150 Berry St with 100 units and an opening in July 2002; it does not say in so many words that Mission Housing developed it. The Assessor's roll for the residential lot records 101 units and 2002 as year built.

item.title: Correction · Rich Sorro Commons: The Rich Sorro Commons page no longer says the Assessor's year built is 2003: that year belongs to a retail lot at 213 King St. The roll entry for 150 Berry St, under lot 8706003, gives 2002 and 101 units, matching the July 2002 opening.

item.title: Correction · Rich Sorro Commons: The developer is named Mission Housing, as on its own project page. The page gives 100 rental units, 158,000 square feet and a childcare center; the earlier figures of 101 units and 174,100 square feet are not used.
item.description: The developer is named Mission Housing, as on its own project page. The page gives 100 rental units, 158,000 square feet and a childcare center; the earlier figures of 101 units and 174,100 square feet are not used. Source: Mission Housing, Rich Sorro Commons (missionhousing.org/richsorro).

item.title: Correction · Rich Sorro Commons: The map notes for Rich Sorro Commons said 101 units, 174,100 square feet, a supportive housing building and a Head Start centre at 152 Berry St. Mission Housing's project page and the DBI permit both say 100 units; the page gives 158,000 square feet, serves families and people with AIDS/HIV, and mentions only 'a childcare center'. A dated correction was recorded, and the summary already said 100 units. The aerial photo credit names the Commons account Firstcultural (Alfred Twu, per its user page) and drops the unsupported 'departing flight' wording.

A dated correction was recorded, and the summary already said 100 units. The aerial photo credit names the Commons account Firstcultural (Alfred Twu, per its user page) and drops the unsupported 'departing flight' wording.
